title: Hearty Middle Eastern Chickpeas Falafel
description: Rich and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring ground coriander and served in a copper mug, perfect for a crowd, this halal-friendly falafel is a true delight. It is made with chickpeas and spices, then flambeed to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and process until well combined.
Add the flour and process until the mixture is smooth and holds together.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small falafel patties.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and flambe the falafel patties until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the falafel to a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
While the falafel is baking, prepare the tahini sauce by mixing the lemon juice and olive oil in a small bowl.
To serve, place a few falafel patties in a copper mug and drizzle with the tahini sauce.
